mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.1%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate above 6.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 6.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand that drives corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, rising industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust manufacturing output that supports corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is rising and the regime is late-cycle, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating inflation above 2.5% annual rate (CPIAUCSL rise) signals impending monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL rises above 2.5% in 12 months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent decline in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) indicates labor market deterioration that reduces consumer confidence and spending, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in PAYEMS and rise in UNRATE fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or the interaction term's Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) above 100 indicates strong manufacturing output that supports corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is above 100, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Declining housing starts below 1000 thousand units signals weak residential construction that reduces consumer spending and corporate revenue, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST is below 1000, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
